# Who may approve a raised baseline row or a new access exception line, one sha256 a line: the hash of the maintainer's
# lower-case GitHub login (python3 -c "import hashlib;print(hashlib.sha256(b'<login>').hexdigest())"), since the
# repository is public and names no person. The approval is an approving review on the pull request by a listed
# maintainer, read from GitHub by scripts/check_review_approval.py in CI's maintainer-review job; no commit message
# approves anything. The list that counts is the one at the pull request's base. Editing this file is itself a rise.
